reason: Owner-approved, protected development-to-production release for the reviewed backend changes merged on 2026-10-17. #1229: new Daily schedules exclude any exact decision (source draft and pick) used by any Daily in the previous 14 days and any source draft used in the previous 7 days, relaxing only on 503 availability for small new sets; existing schedules are unchanged.
